app.name: The Beginners
app.load_failed: We could not load this survey. Please check your connection and try again.
app.offline_ready: This survey will keep working if your connection drops.
preview.banner: Preview only. Answers stay on this device and are not sent anywhere.
resume.title: Welcome back
resume.body: You have answers saved on this device from an earlier visit.
resume.restart_confirm: This will clear your saved answers on this device. Start again?
consent.title: Before you begin
consent.pending: [Draft placeholder: the approved information and consent text will appear here.]
consent.body_student: This survey asks about your studies, school and future plans. It is not a test. There are no right or wrong answers. You do not write your name.
consent.body_teacher: This survey asks about your experience teaching and your students' learning. You do not write your name.
consent.voluntary: Taking part is your choice. You can stop at any time. You can leave out any question you do not want to answer unless it is marked as needed.
consent.assent_question: Do you agree to take part in this survey?
consent.consent_question: Do you agree to take part in this survey?
consent.no: No, I do not want to take part
consent.declined_body: You have chosen not to take part. Nothing has been saved. You can close this page.
nav.fix_errors: Please look at the questions marked below.
q.max_reached: You have already chosen {max}. Untick one to choose another.
q.no_dynamic_options: This question uses your answer to an earlier question.
q.soft_range: Please check this number is right. You can continue if it is.
err.required_rows: Please choose an answer in every row.
err.not_a_number: Please type a number using digits only.
err.below_min: Please type a number of at least {min}.
err.above_max: Please type a number no bigger than {max}.
done.title: Thank you
done.body: You have finished the survey. Thank you.
done.preview_body: Preview finished. In a real survey your answers would now be sent. The record below is what would be stored.
done.new: Next person: start a new survey
home.title: The Beginners survey
home.body: Please open the survey link or scan the QR code your school gave you.
landing.title: Welcome
landing.intro: Thank you for helping with this survey. You do not need to write your name.
landing.role_question: Are you a student or a teacher?
landing.class_question_teacher: Which classes do you mainly teach?
landing.teacher_both: If you teach both, choose one now. You can fill in the other survey afterwards.
landing.offline: You are offline. The survey still works, using what was saved on this device.
landing.unavailable_body: This survey link is not accepting responses right now. Please check with your teacher or the person who gave you the link.
landing.not_yet_open_body: This survey has not opened yet. Please try again on the day your school was told.
landing.closed_body: Thank you for your interest. This survey is no longer accepting responses.
landing.not_configured: This copy of the site is not connected to the survey service yet.
done.sent: Your answers have been sent. Thank you for taking part.
done.queued: Your answers are saved on this device. They will be sent automatically when there is a connection. You can close this page.
done.rejected: We could not send these answers. They are kept on this device. Please tell the teacher or the person who gave you the link.
